head: 7 new music apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These music apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Music charts this week, from NostalgicPod to Tapko Harmony.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store charts this week
means: If you're looking for something new in music, these are small apps people are buying right now.
todo: Open each app's App Store page to check the price, in-app purchases and what it needs before you download.

list.name: NostalgicPod
list.what: A retro-style music player for your own library, home media servers, internet radio and podcasts.

list.name: Midgar - Ambience Effect
list.what: Turns a few simple sounds into moving, layered ambience.

list.name: VU303
list.what: A pocket phrase sampler and pattern sequencer styled after late-'90s hardware, the successor to VU202.

list.name: TONAUT
list.what: A synthesizer, drum machine, sequencer and eight-track tape recorder in one app.

list.name: M8 Music Tracker
list.what: An eight-track music tracker, sequencer and synthesizer from Dirtywave.

list.name: Countoff Pro
list.what: A metronome for counting in a song, without running the whole time.

list.name: Tapko Harmony
list.what: Turns your guitar chords into live vocal harmonies, like a harmony pedal.
